query:
SELECT 
  id, name, businessName, email, phone, preferredChannel, 
  lastOutboundChannel, pipelineStage, opportunityStatus,
  humanTakeover, source,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), createdAt) AS daysSinceCreated,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), lastMessageAt) AS daysSinceLastMsg,
  lastMessageAt, nextFollowUpAt, cadencePosition
FROM leads 
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), createdAt) >= 365
  AND preferredChannel = 'Email'
  AND (opportunityStatus IS NULL OR opportunityStatus NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'abandoned'))
  AND humanTakeover = 0
ORDER BY daysSinceCreated DESC
LIMIT 100;
